rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: regulation

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security

Provides the location for more information regarding an external identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.
UnitOfMeasure specify information structures through industry standards for Units of Measure, Quantity Kinds, Dimensions and Data Types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: performedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `from` Action is performedBy `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Natural Location Identifier (NLI)](https://eccma.org/enli-eccma-natural-location-identifier/) is a 14- or 15-character alphanumeric string standardized by [ISO 8000-118](https://www.iso.org/standard/85428.html) that uniquely identifies a three-dimensional geographic point location. The identifier is generated from geodetic coordinates and elevation data. For electronic storage, the `ISO.NLI:` prefix shall be retained (e.g., `ISO.NLI:41TS8M-A8ELTQ-H2`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sil2

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.
A buildType is a hint that is used to indicate the toolchain, platform, or infrastructure that the build was invoked on.

A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.
Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sil1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Safety Integrity Level 1 under IEC 61508.
A Package that contains a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker cannot mount any anticipated attack.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements with cardinality (number/count) of zero.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
Identifies the size of a software Artifact, in bytes.
A requirementUID is a unique identifier assigned to a Requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact for reporting security vulnerabilities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eori
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/customs-operations/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-number-eori_en) is a unique identifier for businesses undertaking customs operations across European Union customs territory, such as import, export, and transit. It consists of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code followed by a national identifier of up to 15 alphanumeric characters (e.g., `PL1234567890ABCDE`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is considered a draft state and may be modified before being submitted for review.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.
Prescribes the storage of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: filesystemImage

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known to have been deployed and is in use. For a software as a service provider, this implies the software is now available as a service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured

Domain in which the AI package can be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
